notes.title: Now live: Necrology, an easier way to access the beta and bugfixes
notes.content: [h2]Necrology (currently in the beta only!)[/h2][p]We've added a necrology to the game![/p][p]This lists all your fallen soldiers, along with the cause of their deaths. Deaths are easy to miss sometimes, and as a new player their cause might not be fully understood, so this should help you figure out why a soldier might have fallen and how to avoid it next time.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4be781df7a1466b872355bf542440f1ce8b278c6.png"][/img][/h2][h2]An easier way to switch between branches[/h2][p]You can now easily switch to the beta branch (and back to the default one, if you like) right from the main menu![/p][p]Keep in mind that this option only shows up if you have the game's language set to English.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a575c9d55610266b8ada15b416f6829fc53ea20.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Full patch notes:[/h2][h3]Main Game Version 1.0.0.2[/h3][list][*][p]Added a button to switch between beta and stable builds in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “Accept all the different opportunity types” achievement being ungettable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the promoted version of Margrave Mizla and his successor giving less power than specified.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Borbak, long-neck liaison activating with Robert Horka’s arrow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mercer Tarcha occasionally not giving armor to adjacent cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the behaviour of Ibran, eager scout.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation improvements for Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Beta Version 1.0.1.1e[/h3][p]You can now switch to this version from the main menu! Alternatively, right click the game in Steam and go to Properties > Betas.[/p][list][*][p]All fixes and changes from Version 1.0.0.2[/p][/*][*][p]Added Necrology, a list of all card deaths with their causes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hugo dying after winning a battle if the card was previously a Papery Infantry.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: From the Court: Hidden Artwork and More Community Spotlights!
notes.content: [h3]Remember this painting from the main menu?[/h3][p][/p][p]Have you ever looked at it and wondered why it looks so familiar?[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcM_hbGT4y81wuBUn09PVvIL1S4zYGFMjL0G3kaXc8pDa37YU9FuZy9Vfhkxg5_XLZNGX7_21-xgVDFd1Xm7mtvBAi8ae1mx87Mkh99YNZ__-O6YP97Jtb4ryvbNneTy-_8npoH?key=tbMFIoTRJCUZ4Ez1ktEKhw"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Well, this painting is also based on a real one - George Washington's crossing of the Delaware River! This event occurred on the night of December 25th - 26th, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. It was the first move in a complex and surprise military manoeuvre organized by George Washington, the commander-in-chief of the Continental Army. Here's the existing painting  below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/23b479455463c20d84719fc758d956c6fc097b71.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are so many IRL inspirations in this game! We've mentioned some of them in previous From the Court editions, but do you think you can spot any more?[/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: New Public Beta & help us with Community Translations!
notes.content:
[h3]Want to be among the first to try out new features for The Royal Writ? [/h3][p]We've added a new public beta branch! To access it, right click the game on Steam, go to Properties > Betas, and select "public_experimental" from the dropdown menu. [/p][p][/p][p]As this is an experimental branch, new features may not be localised into languages other than English, and you may encounter bugs. As always, any ⁠feedback and bug reports are super appreciated - please just make sure to mention that your feedback is about the beta rather than the current main version. You can even join the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] to drop your feedback and bug reports![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Localisation Feedback [/h3][p]Is there something in the main game that doesn't feel like it's worded quite right? You can now submit suggestions for better translations directly through our [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SyN_E8oyxcLfNGYePHBwnZ7Pt87ZHCRdCyr5S1dgY70/edit?usp=sharing"]localisation sheet[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3]
Here are the updates coming to the beta: [/h3][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.0.1.0e[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a hand size indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Consumable, letter and spy cards no longer count towards the hand size (highly experimental)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new mushroom [b]Silk Shank[/b] that cures one ailment of a card[/p][/*][*][p]Added new letter [b]Paper infantry[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a [i]Royal Copier[/i] event to before the final boss of Act II[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Repka, Tilemaker[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Can be promoted any number of times[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Vaida, Mizanthrope[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Shot: Steals 1 base power from all cards in combat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Feher, Escaped Patient[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inflicted with any ailment:[/p][p]+2 base power[/p][/*][*][p]If it has over 4 ailments:[/p][p]Cure all its ailments[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]The Lady of Misfortune[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]All other cards in its lane gain 1 base power, fall back to hand and are inflicted with [i]Spooked[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kelemen, Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]+2 base power per character card in hand[/p][/*][*][p]Kill a card in hand[/p][p]-1 base power per card in combat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kesi, (Still) Annoying[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Double the base power it steals[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kan, Short-Tempered General[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Also give the knocked-out card 5 base power[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Bombardier Sorbus[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Multiply the projectile’s base power by -1 instead of triggering the projectile[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Doctor Baltazar[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]The brief power of bleeding cards is converted to base power”[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: From the Court: More Art and Community Plays
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Have you had a lovely week, full of good runs and huge hits? It feels like the game launched just yesterday, and somehow it's been over a week now! We've loved seeing you share all your screenshots - runs, decks, silly interactions - so glad you're having fun with the game![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Here's some more of the art from concept stages to full colour![/h3][p]You guys seemed to really like seeing these (honestly, same) so we've got a couple more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/22ab1973ccd85503ec79ce8b4fc204e1f4267b9d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Bluebeard is such a nice shade of blue. God I love birds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/31214895780f6cc77846f35c1e4cecd6ab7894dc.gif"][/img]These guys have so much character even just in the concept sketch stages! Their 'concept sketch' is my best artwork honestly. Also those gems look so nice, my magpie brain is itching to steal them. Don't let King Mikolt know...[/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Community spotlight time! Here's some of the screenshots you've shared with us in our Discord![/h3][p][/p][p]Starting with some of the biggest hits you guys achieved, these are off the charts![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/5b0ae9a7d1af74970f74adf1b956084873b06a6a.png"][/img][i]Credits: Cheychao[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/42eb14660ac80ee2157723c4b63e9da5a0c6641a.png"][/img][i]Credits: Noster[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Okay.. if you thought those were big hits....[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/21b66a95d8fb263a4fc3b8c3aed7c0b5d94af7be.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/d24b7b46a3b589eb0cea6d8a75e368d620c77094.png"][/img][i]Credits: Trainzack[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/5ed4cd74f0da083f3669ef53008a268d3761bbfe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This one is kinda beautiful. It scratches an itch in my brain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/b292f2929c97f4423756cbeafdd27a4b96366a78.png"][/img][i]Credits: Trainzack[/i][/p][p][/p][p]As always, please do keep these coming! notes.title: From the Court: Art Progress, Community Art and Whoa, We Launched??
notes.content: [p]Hello one and all, and welcome to our first ever [b]POST-LAUNCH[/b] From the Court! That's wild to me, the day seemed so far off, and now we're already 23 hours out from launch day! Whether you've been here from the early days or you're new here from Tiny Teams, you're all more than welcome and we hope you enjoy your stay.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]How would you like to see some of the art from concept stages and layout to the final thing?[/h3][p][/p][p]I'm so tempted to show you all of them today, but I've decided I'm going to pace it out and not spoil you with all the before and afters the devs have sent over. It's just tactical okay, how else am I supposed to keep these posts running weekly?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/2815f46505c38f04e4ebb0ac8182409c814bfff0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The nitwits are the banes of my existence but they still do have a weird charm about them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/e5facf35fcff83e817388c95dd68b184683fa8a7.gif"][/img][/p][p]Awww look at those ants go! Queen Cheperka wouldn't stop giving me her army yesterday. I was drowning in ants.[/p][p][/p][p]Wait, have you ever heard of 'Anting'? Apparently crows and other birds, when ill, roll around in ants as a form of self medication. I wonder if King Mikolt has been doing anything of the sort...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/2015f5b2ec93b75bceeeaa23d45f9c0de4d52b0b.png"][/img][/p][p]I guess not.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/332f0f3b0ae218ac0e2324ad1b5872c14243d2f7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]MORE community art from you fantastic people?? [/h3][p][/p][p]You guys are SO talented! Please keep the art coming because wow, I love seeing these critters in your styles![/p][p][/p][p]This one's from [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] community member [b]ratmclovin[/b]![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/ff06999a77bfdeda087a35f8cd3d9bc51a6b9225.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Last but not least, thank you for the reception to us launching the game![/h3][p][/p][p]Seriously, we've been so excited and hoping y'all love the game, and you've all come through! We've been reading through all of your reviews and we're so touched, so many kind and positive words for The Royal Writ 🥹 We're also suuuuuuper close to being 'Very Positive' on the reviews, so if you would be able to take the time to leave your feedback on the Steam page, it would mean the world to us! In the world of indie games, it's every little thing that counts.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/e669c4cc4ef60ae6529aa7f1ddc6a6d096cee52c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for this week's From the Court! We hope you have the best time in the kingdom of Aranfold, and if you aren't playing The Royal Writ this weekend... why?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4ab797ae3c1b871abbb459328a26cec40bdddf97.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Battle Begins: The Royal Writ is Now Available + 20% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
[color=#d4974e][i]🎺 Cue fanfare 🎺[/i][/color]

[color=#d4974e][i]Royal Decree from His Majesty, King Mikolt[/i][/color]

My beloved subjects, this most awaited day has arrived! 

The Royal Writ is now available for the kingdom to experience. Command your warriors, witness their noble sacrifices, and bring glory to our realm!

In celebration of this joyous occasion, the royal court shall offer a [b]20% launch discount[/b] for the next two weeks - consider it a gift from the crown to you, the best subjects a king could hope for.

We have something a little extra for those amongst you who are connoisseurs of fine card games -  you'll find The Royal Writ pairs excellently with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400510/Dungeons__Degenerate_Gamblers/"]Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers[/url] in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57372/The_Yogscast_Decktacular/]special bundle[/url]. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f47705c06dfcbe9d8f3c5a82ba1895106ac9629c.png[/img]

In the spirit of inter-kingdom diplomacy, we've welcomed some... [i]questionable[/i] visitors to our realm. Keep your eyes peeled for [b]Ebe & Ghuba[/b] - two dogs in a trench coat who've wandered over from the taverns of [b]Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers[/b]. These fellas have somehow convinced our border guards they're a single, respectable citizen. We are not fooled, but we admire their dedication to the con.

                                                         [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/5a16b308fe10f6dbb054c79669c32108f466e1e0.png[/img]

The army is yours to command, my fine folks! The battles are yours to fight, and the legends are yours to create. Go forth unto victory!


https://youtu.be/ab3rvC2SQpc?feature=shared


[i]A humble request from the royal court:[/i]
If our kingdom has earned thy favour, we would be most grateful for a review on the royal scrolls of Steam! Such endorsements are among our most powerful weapons in the great battlefield of Steam - they help our game appear before more players like thyself, especially crucial just upon launch. And should thy friends seek worthy games for their collections, we would be honoured by their wishlists as well! (Pls review and wishlist thx <3)

Your support means more to this old crow than all the gold in the royal treasury!


[i]P.S., Our humble game is one of this year's [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams[/url] champions! Be sure to check out all the amazing games made by micro studios that we get to share the spotlight with![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/c27342dfc978c1a56253c3462f3f32a709c2f75a.png[/img]


[i]And finally, a word about our friends over at [b]Just[/b]:[/i]
We've teamed up with some lovely folk who believe in rewarding the amazing content our community creates. If you're already sharing screenshots, creating fan art, posting clips on social media, or helping new players, why not get a little something back for it?

[b]Just[/b] has set up some fun challenges where you can upload the content you're already making to your usual social spots, submit them over to [b]Just[/b], and the best submissions earn rewards each month. Your creations stay yours, of course, and there's more good stuff coming.

If that sounds like your sort of thing, check them out [url=https://justabout.com/]here[/url] - good luck!

notes.title: From the Court: Ludum Dare to Today and the Ant Army!
notes.content: [h3]Greetings, loyal subjects![/h3][h3][/h3][p]Welcome back to the court, we always love having you here every week![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Have you seen what the game looked like back in Ludum Dare?[/h3][p][/p][p]Ludum Dare is an online event where developers are challenge to create a game from scratch in a weekend! They've been around since 2002 and run every April and October with a specific theme. The Royal Writ was created as a part of Ludum Dare 55, how cool is that? And now here we are with a game that is being fully fledged right before our eyes. Here's some before and after screenshots of what the game looked like back then compared to where it is now - [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/319b9bf2a5ed579fc5253ff9b34a12a03ce64cfd.png"][/img][i]The City Before[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a08738b9c3ced92a43a2d77b9d4dfb410818d80.jpg"][/img][i]The City Now[/i][/p][p][/p][p]You can really see how much has changed from the early days, this was back in early 2024![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f4a739b4881812e05e7d956321ba934017544bb3.png"][/img][i]Shady Bargain Before[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/9ba8aa50f76f420a89bb5a0dda00b7cc3d2e77a1.jpg"][/img][i]Shady Bargain Now[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I don't think I can fangirl over the art style enough, it's so darn cute I need like 5 tattoos.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]One of our producers has achieved peak Ant.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/953de24723836fbe7013664e44be3ce0e870d061.png"][/img][/p][p]These darn ants... pretty signific-ant if you ask me. There are definitely ants in Simon's pants about this. You can't be ignor-ant about the ant army... okay okay I'll stop.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Nottingham Video Games Expo - Thanks for coming by![/h3][p][/p][p]It was so much fun to meet you guys and watch your strategies, even some of you beating the demos! (So I've been told, I wasn't there. Sounded fun though, I'm not jealous or anything.) [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f19e7a6648b33c2a14f7a8ac214f2d7d07c28982.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for playing the game and for all your kind words! We're less than a week away from launch and really hope you're just as excited as we are![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is me after this long week. And probably for the forseeable future as I have given my life away to The Royal Writ. It has consumed me. It's too addictive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/349bdd4e002c3553a93f7fb448f34a64b6a6c08f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: From The Court: Early Build Chaos and Nottingham Video Games Expo!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to the 4th edition of From The Court - my, how time flies! We got our release date announcement last weekend (7th August for those of you slacking and didn't know yet), and now it feels like it's rushing up to us real quick. Just under 2 weeks away!

[/p][h3]Have a look at some of these early development shenanigans[/h3][p][/p][p]These are pretty old bugs when the devs first stared to try and expand the scope of the game[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/c1939f288f5b3547eab389f61f5252d09de44d30.png"][/img][/p][p]This one is an asset in a wrong space, when they were first testing out the wonderwheel. Funny how one small thing can lead to something like this! My dev expertise is limited to my comp sci classes back in high school and first year of engineering, so this is fascinating.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f9142fd6b8f87e7b55881b892aa86d2783897774.png"][/img][/p][p]Here we have a picture of them trying to make the randomly generated map nodes work, but that took so much more time than expected! It's like a spider web. A spider web of confusion that even the spider would get lost in. It's me, I'm the [url="https://i.pinimg.com/736x/b9/c2/dc/b9c2dcd2944f8bcdeecd18a16c8c8069.jpg"]spider[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Now, this one...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/31458efa2693f9924c2f91ad5257eec3e8eed629.png"][/img][/p][p]When I first saw this, I just had to know what on earth was going on.[/p][p][/p][p]"This one is funny, for some reason whenever we try to add some blur effects in Godot something always goes wrong, so we usually try some other solutions to make visuals more clear. But this time we persevered and had to go through bugs like this haha"[/p][p][/p][p]All this for a bit of blur. The things our lovely developers go through to bring us a quality game.[/p][p][/p][p]This last one is my favourite.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/854add3599737854a7411e5cee6cca4b47e9099e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As a bird lover ([url="https://imgur.com/a/fup8toi"][i]bird tax[/i][/url][i] of my old girl and her kids[/i]) I 1000% love whatever is going on here. [/p][p][/p][p]"Finding actually good fonts for the game was hard, this is a representation of a point where we gave up haha"[/p][p][/p][p]Honestly? Totally fair.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]We're at the Nottingham Video Games Expo this weekend![/h3][p][/p][p]Not me, but you can catch our Product Manager, Matt, and our Video Editor, Reece at the expo! If you're around, say hi, play the game, and snag some of these super cool goodies![/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/2ed0dc3207811fc6bba51cea8194a593b7112461.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/9f93f76ae546fa7c978659ac49b6a18e04aea323.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Matt handmade these himself with a whole lot of love so you know they're [i]extra [/i]cool stickers. Look at those wax seals! There's a whole variety of colours to choose from (except yellow, apparently we forgot entirely about the existence of yellow) and they're limited to the expo only![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're as geared up for launch day as we are! It's been so much fun and excitement during this whole journey to bring the game to you guys. Catch you in the next From The Court![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/661a978da084fce0a3471028d18ddb812550517b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Slay the Spire style deckbuilder with brutal, gut-wrenching twist gets new demo
notes.content:
Sometimes the only road to victory is to sacrifice some of the cards in your hand and hope for better ones. In The Royal Writ, sacrificing your cards is just as crucial as playing them. Blending deckbuilders and roguelikes in true Slay the Spire fashion, placing your army of battle-hardened animals requires true strategy, asking you if you're brave enough to sacrifice the required troops to ensure victory. Permanently. Oh, and it's free to play now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Grim and joyful deckbuilder The Royal Writ is coming for genre king Balatro next month
notes.content:
The Fool King is dead, long live the Deckbuilder King. The Decking, if you will. Publishers Yogscast Games have announced that festive card-based roguelite The Royal Writ will launch on 7th August.

The Royal Writ seems pretty spesh, and yet, we have never covered it before, because we are blundering philistines. Sorry about that. In our defence, this is yet another cousin of Balatro on some level, and there's only so many of those I can process in one year before my thumbs and eyes swell up in protest. But based on a quick snort of the Steam demo, The Royal Writ stands apart thanks to 1) immensely jovial animated storybook visuals 2) an interesting set of card sacrifice mechanics. Here is a trailer.

Read more

notes.title: From the Court: A Lively World and an Exciting Showcase!
notes.content:
[p]Wake up Kingdom, it's time for another From The Court! We love asking the devs about their inspirations and thought processes during development and sharing them when you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Have you ever paid much attention to the background in game?[/h3][p][/p][p]I know I wanted to put little animations everywhere in the game, because generally not a lot of deckbuilders use 2d hand-drawn animations, and us working with it all the time it seemed like an opportunity to stand out visually this way. While it is a ton of work going through all the traditional animation phases (layout-animation-cleanup-coloring) it has such a unique vibe that we didn’t want to cut corners in this way.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/0f55bd55981074d9b0750b89816933ea09dfdc78.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]One example is that all the backgrounds have little characters going about their day, all of them do something fun if you happen to take a look at it.[/p][p][/p][p]We love the little details![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Secret Sauce is TOMORROW??[/h3][p][/p][p]Y'all. Time has simply crept up on us. We've been so so excited for this event and to hopefully welcome loads of new people into our [strike]royal and amazing kingdom[/strike] humble little community! The debut showcase premieres at [b]11 AM PDT / 2 PM EST / 7 PM BST / 8 PM CEST[/b]. ICYMI: We've got a pretty exciting announcement during the showcase so you definitely don't want to miss it 👀[/p][p][/p][p]You can watch it at any of the below links![/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkAY-R_v4sY" style="button" buttoncolor="#24705f"]Offbrand Games YouTube[/url] [url="https://www.twitch.tv/ludwig" style="button" buttoncolor="#24705f"]Ludwig Twitch[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ludwig" style="button" buttoncolor="#24705f"]Ludwig YouTube[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4e63127f75048f6d648865dc139886c82b0510c3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
Alright love y'all, support us in the showcase, let us know if you caught the big announcement and remember, permadeath will haunt you:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/b6071a0ded073bbf78eb3ecbea27fdab43922f68.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Losing Time, Lego Inspirations and Community Art!
notes.content: [h2]Welcome back to another royal decree From the Court![/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]⏰Have you ever caught yourself playing The Royal Writ so much that you've almost missed something important?[/h3][p][/p][p]Well, our MD, Simon sure did. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/fe20e7f71e787f27697c40721727f91c869b6fae.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p]What's the longest you've played in one sitting? I feel like we should probably throw a warning label on the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🐑 If you're a hardcore LEGO fan, you may have noticed something...[/h3][p][/p][p]Have you ever wondered why some of the characters look a little bit familiar?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe_Kj5wZCsMmv4cBRga7mirLq5DQHU_3e3PRc866vBo2BMsuNVlzardZ-6vQF-hNDP1iPMJMylNb1gdSrs67R3qUZQExWDKvxsZr3J7usa8IMu6x1HkF4uLTG3SpFsDgGT9t4VPXA?key=tbMFIoTRJCUZ4Ez1ktEKhw"][/img][/p][p]Straight from the dev, Kornél: [i]As I’m an avid collector of old LEGO sets, it's no wonder that a lot of times I’m inspired by their whimsical world. I’m especially a big fan of Fabuland, which I think found a perfect balance with their characters’ proportions and general cuteness, so from that point on they were the blueprint and some of the earliest characters are very much directly based on them.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Fabuland was introduced in 1979, btw. That's so much older than I am.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's another set that Kornél shared with us, you might notice the Robert Horka inspiration![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/b8c7fdb568a929eadb503632425cce5d7d985c07.jpg"][/img][i]This is the Camouflaged Outpost from way back in 1987![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And a personal favourite from Kornél, the Fabulands fellas on their steamboat from 1985.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/418ea781125956f0961e6bb33c382c794c215dfb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Inspiration can really come from anywhere![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🔎 Community Spotlight: Our King by BubbleWizardOG[/h3][p][/p][p]One of our community members has graciously immortalised the King in a royal portrait! Thank you for this super cool drawing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/386192794cde69b14a7325a02db30696c059ea0b.png"][/img][i][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wladternovik/photo/7523566270705388822?lang=en-GB"]@wladternovik[/url][/i] [i]on TikTok[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you have anything cool to share with us, don't forget to join the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] and do so, we love seeing your stuff![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time 🫡[/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Huge Numbers, 4 Legged Creatures and Snakes Breaking Reality
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, royal subjects,[/h2][p][/p][p]This week we're sharing some fun little tidbits from the world of The Royal Writ![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔢 Community member Balthromaw has been hitting some absolutely wild numbers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/8fcc8a5ff39712b049cb9130be51f6f71cb19be0.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for sharing the pics with us, Balthromaw, just a matter of fixing the exploit now hah![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🖼️ You might have noticed this intriguing little easter egg painting while playing the demo[/b]...[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/eae010ac311b33687a64c000c2e3039ec67db07a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Deep lore...? What's the deal with four-legged animals among our anthropomorphic ones?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Here's some fun trivia: this artwork is inspired by a section of "Arrival of the Hungarians" - a circular panorama created by Hungarian painter Árpád Feszty between 1892 and 1894. The original masterpiece stands around 15m (50 ft) tall and stretches 120m (400 ft) long, featuring roughly 2000 people![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/fca829b5e40c066b804fac83cdc606ce92c2b70f.png"][/img][i](The segment that inspired the painting)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Our version is... considerably simpler :') Check it out in the [b]Options[/b] menu when you try the demo![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐍 Last but not least, here's a gem from development - one small oversight that spawned an infinite loop[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/916d9fc89035058a42c18e12523c45073333164b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Borbak's ability is that you get a letter card if it enters a hazard[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4f752115919831163592cf00a295c6d6b686cf9d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's a relic that removes the starting letters from your letter pool, and instead adds a letter card which floods the battlefield with hazards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/5e7deda004f1a6e559bef0cea3ad94b13aa27fdf.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]This way you create an infinite loop of.. well... what you see in the gif above :')[/p][p][/p][p]If you've got anything fun to show us, do drop it in the Steam Forums or in the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] and we might share it in the next From the Court![/p]

notes.title: A Most Regal Calendar: Your Month, Your Character!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, loyal subjects![/p][p][/p][p]Have you ever booted up The Royal Writ demo, built your deck with your favourite characters and wondered, 'Hmm... I wonder which one of these super cool animals I would be?' (If you say no, we'll know you're lying. We think about it all the time.)[/p][p][/p][p]Well don't we have just the thing for that! Wonder no more, as we bring you The Royal Writ's Your Month, Your Character![/p][p][/p][p]Discover which [strike]silly[/strike] valiant animal warrior represents your birth month, and [i]obviously[/i] that means it represents you the best.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/c36a768ecb58608e24f06ad14d729811c6ff3735.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Are you a January [b]Osvat[/b], the mace menace, or perhaps a December [b]Domokosh[/b] with mysterious powers? Maybe the powerful May [b]Kosha [/b](our social media manager was totally not biased while making this).[/p][p][/p][p]Each one of these characters brings their own personality and abilities to the battlefield. From the dreaded [b]Tax Collector[/b] of February (we all know that feeling) to the adorab...[i]ahem[/i], [b]Fearful One[/b] of November, every month has its champion ready to march into battle for you![/p][p][/p][p]Which character are you? Tell us in the discussions, we'd love to know! (I'm Cheperka, I get to build an ant army:) )[/p][p][/p][p]
                         [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/691292d3b462284bbc27f7cc97084318b90c87d7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to try out our demo in the Steam Next Fest and meet all these characters and more![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710820/The_Royal_Writ_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh" style="button" buttoncolor="#c8453c"]Join the Discord![/url][/p]
